rules: The model selects topic IDs only. Domains and groups are derived from topic placements by code; the model never names a domain.
Select every topic the record substantively covers, and none that it merely mentions. Zero topics is valid; keep the record and use unmapped_concepts.
A topic may sit in several domains (placements). A record therefore appears in several domain views but is counted once overall. Domain counts overlap and must not be added together.
The first placement is the topic's home domain, and the ID prefix matches the home domain's prefix.
An ID is never reused for a different meaning. A retired or moved ID is listed in legacy_ids of its successor(s). A topic carved out of a topic that still exists lists it in split_from.
Use a sector topic for a sector measure (flood defences = WAT-03). Use a Disaster Risk Management topic only when the subject is the cross-sector disaster-risk system itself.
Membership of the Climate domain does not establish climate causation; an earthquake is never climate evidence.

domains.label: Climate
domains.definition: Climate-specific cross-sector policy: governance, finance, transparency, economy-wide mitigation, climate information and loss and damage. Sector measures use their sector domain.

domains.label: Agriculture & Food
domains.definition: Crops, soils, livestock, rangelands, farm water, fisheries and food systems.

domains.label: Disaster Risk Management
domains.definition: All-hazards disaster-risk systems: governance, risk knowledge, warning and preparedness, response, recovery and risk finance, whether or not the hazard is climate-related.

domains.label: Water
domains.definition: Water resources, supply, basins, drought, floods and coasts, water quality and the cryosphere as a water source.

domains.label: Nature, Forests & Land
domains.definition: Forests, land, land degradation, biodiversity, ecosystems and land carbon.

domains.label: Energy
domains.definition: Energy supply, renewables, grids, efficiency, heating, fossil-fuel transition and methane.

domains.label: Settlements & Infrastructure
domains.definition: Buildings, settlements, land-use planning, urban heat and critical infrastructure. Membership does not establish urban geographic scope.

domains.label: Transport
domains.definition: Vehicles, fuels, mobility services and transport-network resilience.

domains.label: Industry & Mining
domains.definition: Industrial production, processes, industrial resilience, mining and extractives.

domains.label: Health
domains.definition: Climate- and disaster-related health risks and health services.

domains.label: Waste & Circular Economy
domains.definition: Materials and recycling, solid waste and landfill methane, wastewater.

domains.label: Economy & Transition
domains.definition: Economic diversification, economic resilience, just transition and restructuring of climate-exposed or fossil-dependent economies.

domains.label: Livelihoods & Social Protection
domains.definition: Jobs and livelihood resilience, social protection and safety nets, and displacement, migration and planned relocation.

domains.label: Culture & Heritage
domains.definition: Tangible and intangible heritage and local or traditional knowledge.

domains.label: Education & Knowledge
domains.definition: Education, public awareness, research, data and knowledge systems.

domains.label: Tourism
domains.definition: Tourism systems, destinations and tourism-dependent livelihoods. Use only when the tourism sector is explicit.

topics.label: Climate planning, governance and mainstreaming
topics.definition: Climate strategies and laws, institutional arrangements, coordination bodies, and mainstreaming climate into sector or budget planning.

routing.when: the subject is a finance or support mechanism
the institution is a disaster-risk or civil-protection body

topics.label: Climate finance and support
topics.definition: Mobilising, channelling or requesting finance, technology transfer and capacity support for climate action, where the finance arrangement itself is the subject.

routing.when: an amount funds one sector project
routing.use: the sector topic, with a finance fact

routing.when: insurance, contingency funds or risk pools for disasters

topics.label: Climate observations, projections and impact assessment
topics.definition: Observed climate trends, climate projections, and climate vulnerability or impact assessments.

routing.when: a multi-hazard risk assessment, hazard map or disaster-loss database

topics.label: Climate transparency and reporting
topics.definition: Greenhouse-gas inventories, MRV systems, progress tracking and reporting under the UNFCCC.

routing.when: climate observations or projections rather than reporting systems

topics.label: Economy-wide emissions targets and pathways
topics.definition: Economy-wide greenhouse-gas targets, carbon-neutrality goals and long-term emission pathways.

routing.when: a land sink or removals target

topics.label: Loss and damage
topics.definition: Economic and non-economic losses from climate-change impacts framed as loss and damage, and arrangements to address them.

routing.when: losses from one disaster event reported without loss-and-damage framing

topics.label: Disaster risk governance and institutions
topics.definition: Disaster-risk-reduction strategies and laws, civil-protection or emergency-management agencies and coordination mechanisms.

routing.when: climate strategy or climate coordination bodies

topics.label: Disaster risk assessment and loss data
topics.definition: Hazard mapping, multi-hazard risk assessments, exposure and vulnerability databases, and disaster-loss accounting, including reported event losses.

routing.when: climate projections or climate impact studies

topics.label: Early warning and preparedness
topics.definition: Monitoring and forecasting for warnings, warning dissemination, contingency plans, drills, stockpiles and readiness to act.

topics.label: Multi-hazard risk reduction programmes
topics.definition: Cross-sector programmes that reduce exposure or vulnerability to several hazards and have no single sector home. This is the residual home; prefer sector topics.

topics.label: Disaster risk finance and insurance
topics.definition: Contingency and reserve funds, insurance schemes, risk pools, catastrophe bonds and other pre-arranged disaster finance.

topics.label: Emergency response and civil protection
topics.definition: Search and rescue, evacuation, emergency relief and civil-protection operations during or immediately after an event.

topics.label: Recovery and reconstruction
topics.definition: Post-disaster needs assessment, recovery frameworks, rebuilding (including building back better) and restoration of services and livelihoods.

topics.label: Irrigation and farm water efficiency
topics.definition: Irrigation systems, on-farm water efficiency, drainage and farm water storage.

topics.label: Resilient crops and soils
topics.definition: Crop varieties, cropping practices, on-farm soil health and agricultural adaptation of production.

topics.label: Livestock, pastures and rangelands
topics.definition: Livestock production and health, manure and enteric emissions, pasture and rangeland management.

topics.label: Food security and farm livelihoods
topics.definition: Food availability and access, value chains, farm incomes and rural agricultural livelihoods.

topics.label: Fisheries and aquaculture
topics.definition: Capture fisheries, aquaculture and the ecosystems and livelihoods they depend on.

topics.label: Water supply and groundwater
topics.definition: Drinking and municipal water supply, water storage and groundwater management.

topics.label: River basins and transboundary water
topics.definition: Basin planning, water allocation between users and sectors, and transboundary water cooperation.

topics.label: Flood and coastal protection
topics.definition: Structural and nature-based flood, river-bank and coastal protection, and floodplain management.

topics.label: Water quality and reuse
topics.definition: Receiving-water quality, pollution control and water reuse.

topics.label: Glaciers, snow and mountain water
topics.definition: Changes in glaciers, snowpack and permafrost as water sources, and their monitoring or management.

routing.when: a glacial-lake outburst flood as an event or warning
routing.use: the hazard facet with DRM-02 or DRM-03

topics.label: Drought management
topics.definition: Drought monitoring, drought plans, drought response measures and water-shortage management.

routing.when: on-farm drought adaptation such as crops or fodder

topics.label: Forest management and health
topics.definition: Forest management, afforestation, forest health and wildfire prevention in forests.

topics.label: Species, habitats and protected areas
topics.definition: Species conservation, habitats and protected-area systems.

topics.label: Ecosystem restoration
topics.definition: Active restoration of degraded ecosystems such as wetlands, steppe and riparian zones.

topics.label: Land carbon and removals
topics.definition: Land-use, land-use change and forestry (LULUCF) sinks, removals and their accounting.

routing.use: NAT-02 or NAT-03 only with evidence

topics.label: Land degradation, desertification and salinity
topics.definition: Combating desertification, land degradation, sand encroachment, soil salinisation and erosion at landscape scale.

topics.label: Renewable electricity
topics.definition: Renewable power generation such as solar, wind, hydro and geothermal.

topics.label: Grids and energy storage
topics.definition: Transmission, distribution, grid flexibility and storage, including grid resilience.

routing.when: a generating plant without grid measures

topics.label: Clean heating and fuels
topics.definition: District heating, heat pumps and cleaner heating or cooking fuels.

topics.label: Energy efficiency and demand management
topics.definition: Economy-wide or cross-sector efficiency and demand management.

routing.when: a building, industrial or transport measure

topics.label: Fossil energy transition
topics.definition: Coal, oil and gas phase-down, fuel switching and transition of fossil energy systems.

routing.when: worker and community impacts of the transition

topics.label: Oil and gas methane
topics.definition: Methane leakage, venting and flaring in oil, gas and coal-mine operations.

topics.label: Energy-system climate resilience
topics.definition: Exposure of power plants, hydropower and fuel supply to climate hazards, including drought and glacier loss affecting hydropower, heat affecting thermal plants, and the water-energy nexus.

routing.when: glacier and snowmelt water supply as such

topics.label: Building energy performance
topics.definition: Building codes, retrofits and energy performance of buildings.

topics.label: Resilient settlements, infrastructure and land-use planning
topics.definition: Risk-informed spatial and land-use planning, building safety, resilient housing, and continuity of public, communications and multi-utility infrastructure without a single sector home.

topics.label: Urban heat and green space
topics.definition: Urban cooling, green and blue infrastructure, and parks.

topics.label: Low-emission vehicles and fuels
topics.definition: Vehicle efficiency, electric vehicles and low-carbon transport fuels.

topics.label: Public, active and shared mobility
topics.definition: Public transport, walking, cycling and shared mobility.

topics.label: Resilient transport networks
topics.definition: Protecting roads, rail, ports and airports from hazards and maintaining access.

topics.label: Cleaner production and industrial efficiency
topics.definition: Industrial energy and resource efficiency and cleaner production.

topics.label: Process emissions and refrigerants
topics.definition: Industrial process emissions, F-gases and refrigerants.

topics.label: Industrial climate and disaster resilience
topics.definition: Protecting industrial sites and supply chains from hazards, including technological-accident risk.

topics.label: Mining and critical minerals
topics.definition: Climate and risk aspects of mining, critical minerals and extractive-sector transition, including tailings safety.

topics.label: Heat and human health
topics.definition: Heat-health action plans, heat-related illness and health protection during heat.

topics.label: Climate-sensitive disease and exposure
topics.definition: Vector-, water- and food-borne disease, air quality and other climate-sensitive health exposures.

topics.label: Resilient health services
topics.definition: Health-system preparedness, safe and continuous health facilities and surveillance capacity.

topics.label: Materials, recycling and circularity
topics.definition: Waste prevention, recycling and circular-economy measures.

topics.label: Solid-waste disposal and methane
topics.definition: Landfills, landfill gas and solid-waste disposal.

topics.label: Wastewater and sanitation
topics.definition: Sewerage, wastewater treatment and sanitation services.

topics.label: Economic diversification and resilience
topics.definition: Diversifying climate-exposed or fossil-dependent economies and strengthening economic resilience.

topics.label: Just transition and economic restructuring
topics.definition: Fair management of transition impacts on workers, regions and communities.

topics.label: Jobs and resilient livelihoods
topics.definition: Employment, skills for green jobs and livelihood resilience outside a single sector.

topics.label: Social protection and safety nets
topics.definition: Cash transfers, adaptive and shock-responsive social protection, and safety nets.

topics.label: Displacement, migration and planned relocation
topics.definition: Disaster and climate displacement, migration and planned relocation of communities.

topics.label: Heritage risk, conservation and recovery
topics.definition: Hazard and climate-impact assessments of tangible or intangible heritage, and protecting, adapting and restoring heritage sites and cultural assets.

topics.label: Local knowledge and cultural continuity
topics.definition: Traditional and local knowledge and cultural practices used or protected in climate and risk policy.

routing.when: local knowledge applied within a sector practice, such as herding or irrigation
routing.use: the sector topic; add CUL-03 only when the knowledge itself is the subject

topics.label: Climate and disaster education
topics.definition: Curricula, school programmes and formal or vocational education on climate and disaster risk.

topics.label: Public awareness campaigns
topics.definition: Public awareness and behaviour campaigns on climate and disaster risk.

routing.when: dissemination of warnings for a specific hazard

topics.label: Research, data and knowledge systems
topics.definition: Research programmes and institutions, data infrastructure and knowledge-sharing platforms.

topics.label: Tourism adaptation and destination resilience
topics.definition: Adapting tourism destinations and services to climate and disaster risk.

topics.label: Tourism resource efficiency
topics.definition: Energy, water and waste efficiency in tourism.
